fixture.note: the sentinel is outside the cleanup root and inside an explicitly test-owned safe parent

actualMechanism.mechanism: owned-root.safeCleanup (no-follow: descendant links removed by name, then recursive removal)

platformHazardProbe.observedConclusion: node rmSync(recursive) did NOT traverse the junction on this platform; the trailing-separator shell form is the measured hazard (recorded in the design note) and is defeated by removing links by name first

trailingSeparatorHazard.recordedBy: manual probe during C2 design (see docs/engineering/trajectory-p2e0.md)
trailingSeparatorHazard.mitigation: safeCleanup removes every descendant reparse point BY NAME (rmdirSync/unlinkSync, non-recursive) BEFORE any recursive removal, so no trailing-separator form can be reached
